The Top Line
 

Here’s the deal. We’re all about helping researchers break free from tools that just don’t cut it. Unleashing problem-tackling solutions that make a huge difference in the real science they do every day. That’s our mantra, our promise and we own it. Our tribe is different. We thrive on moving fast, taking risks and persevering through failure. We embrace the unknown and we are happy to make mistakes. We are there for each other and we crave diversity because we know that building a truly diverse tribe will make us better at everything.
 

The Job
 

Come work with an all-star product development team to make tools that solve our customers’ most pressing needs. Work on a wide range of products and technologies, right from the early stages all the way to the final launch, developing cool solutions and overcoming technical challenges along the way. Get gritty: determine what the system needs, run tests, troubleshoot problems and make things work. You will be part of a small team that covers all the different disciplines that come into play when developing a new instrument (hardware, software, science, algorithms, etc.). This is a great opportunity to work in a fun and challenging environment where you can make a real impact.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Work with mechanical designers on prototyping and developing new hardware 

• Build small software tools to help test or calibrate the hardware 

• Work closely with the manufacturing engineer to support the transfer to production 

• Report progress in weekly meetings 

• Be ready to be part of a multidisciplinary team and contribute wherever you can  

Qualifications
 
 

• Master or equivalent in Engineering field 

• Exceptional problem-solving skills 

• Analytical mindset 

• Fluent in Dutch and English 

• Experience in programming or strong will to learn 

• LabVIEW experience/knowledge is an asset but not required 

• SolidWorks/Onshape knowledge are a plus 

• Excellent documentation, organizational, teamwork, troubleshooting, problem solving, and communication skills  

Location and Compensation
 

This is a full-time, onsite position in Ghent, Belgium. The gross monthly salary range is €4,000–€5,000, depending on experience and level. Benefits include €10 meal vouchers, medical insurance and group insurance.

For an international manufacturing company in the Aalst region, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to work in a 2-shift system. You will help ensure the optimal operation of an advanced machinery and equipment park, while having the opportunity to further develop your technical skills.

You will work in a 2-shift system from 06:00 to 14:00 and from 14:00 to 22:00.

Your tasks and responsibilities

• As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving industrial machinery and technical installations. Thanks to your technical expertise, you will help keep production processes reliable and minimise downtime.
• Carrying out preventive maintenance on production machines, injection moulding machines and auxiliary equipment.
• Troubleshooting and resolving electrical, mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic faults.
• Carrying out corrective repairs in the event of technical failures.
• Analysing faults and identifying sustainable solutions.
• Independently carrying out small technical projects and improvements.
• Actively contributing to optimisations aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of the machinery.
• Working closely with the production department to minimise downtime.
• Working in accordance with applicable safety, quality and environmental standards.
• Contributing to a clean, safe and orderly working environment.

• You have a technical degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation or a similar technical field. Relevant practical experience can also be considered.
• You have experience in maintaining and repairing industrial machinery.
• You have knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance in a production environment.
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is an advantage. If you have limited experience in this area, you will have the opportunity to learn and develop your skills internally.
• Experience with injection moulding machines is an advantage, but not a requirement.
• You have a good command of Dutch.
• You are able to understand technical documentation in English and/or German.
• You have strong analytical skills and a solution-oriented approach.
• You have a hands-on mentality and a strong sense of responsibility.
• You enjoy working as part of a team, while also being able to carry out technical interventions independently.

Are you ready to start your career as a Maintenance Technician in a dynamic and technology-driven environment? As a Maintenance Technician, you'll be at the forefront of ensuring the optimal performance of our client's advanced machinery.

If you're eager to embark on a fulfilling career, we encourage you to apply and become a valuable part of our team dedicated to innovation and excellence.

Katoen Natie Gent is a logistics company specializing in storage, transport and handling of goods. Based in the city of Ghent in Belgium, the company has offices around the world. Katoen Natie was founded in 1854 and has since grown into an international player in logistics and supply chain management. Katoen Natie Ghent is an important employer in the Ghent region and has strong ties with the local community. The company has taken several initiatives in the past to support the local economy and has invested in sustainable logistics and innovation.

Jobomschrijving

 

Just graduated and have recently obtained your bachelor's degree? Interested in a leadership role? Our client, Katoen Natie in Ghent, has a vacancy for a Supply Chain Trainee.

 

 

Grow into a leadership position with the Supply Chain Traineeship

 

 

As a Supply Chain Trainee, you will have the opportunity to advance to a leadership role within one of our logistics operations within a span of 2 years. Your logistics career will take off with an extensive on-the-job training program lasting approximately 2 years. The emphasis is on developing operational skills, leadership qualities, and specialization.

 

A diverse journey.

 

 

Throughout this exploratory experience, you will have the chance to become familiar with various operations and clients. This will enable you to discover the possibilities available to you within the company. There will be a total of 4 evaluation moments during the program. Depending on your competencies and interests, you may progress to a leadership position, such as a team leader overseeing a team/department and being responsible for guiding and coaching your team within a specific department.

 

 

 

• You have obtained a bachelor's degree in logistics, business or business management, trade, etc.
• Or you have an A2 diploma with relevant work experience, such as team leader, shift leader, supervisor, logistics employee, forklift driver, ambitious warehouse employee, etc.
• You speak fluent English and Dutch

• You have a hands-on mentality and are willing to actively get things done.

D-NETWORK is looking for an IT Engineering Manager for an international medical technology company based in Mechelen.

 

The Opportunity :

Our client is looking for an Engineering Manager – Product Platform to strengthen the foundations of its platform engineering organisation. You will lead a group of engineering contributors and make sure the underlying software platforms stay reliable, compliant and ready for future growth.

You will manage Tech Leads and Software Engineers and keep the different teams and functions aligned. You are responsible for the health, stability and evolution of the platforms, balancing people leadership, technical direction and delivery quality. In a regulated medical device setting, you will work closely with engineering, verification, quality, security and regulatory colleagues to deliver solutions that are both innovative and compliant.

This role suits a leader who pairs technical credibility with strong people skills and enjoys complex, cross-functional environments.

 

Key Responsibilities

Build and grow the engineering team

• Foster an engineering culture centred on dependable delivery, quality and continuous improvement
• Coach and develop Tech Leads and engineers, building leadership depth and succession readiness
• Set clear priorities and structured leadership routines in a safe, inclusive team environment
• Drive hiring, onboarding and long-term capability planning
Guide technical direction and platform integrity

• Define and evolve the technical roadmap for the platform components
• Contribute to architecture and design governance together with the Tech Leads
• Stay close to the most complex technical challenges and risk areas
• Promote modern practices such as secure coding, CI/CD and automation
Align teams and deliveries

• Coordinate software, embedded, verification, quality and regulatory teams
• Manage dependencies, integration points and release-readiness milestones
• Simplify the architecture and improve platform interfaces and boundaries
Lead through Tech Leads and strengthen governance

• Lead a group of Tech Leads across platform domains, with clear ownership and accountability
• Set up solid governance routines (design reviews, decision logs, roadmap alignment)
• Embed the discipline required in regulated environments: traceability, testability and reproducibility
Partner with stakeholders

• Work with R&D, Quality, Regulatory and Delivery colleagues
• Report clearly on platform health, risks and progress
• Keep technical debt and defects visible and properly prioritised
Champion quality and compliance

• Ensure compliance with medical device regulations and the company’s quality management system
• Build quality into everyday engineering practice
• Balance agile delivery with regulatory rigour

Your Profile

Required

• Master’s or PhD in a relevant scientific or engineering discipline (or equivalent). For degrees obtained outside Belgium, a formal recognition process may be part of the hiring journey, and support will be provided
• Proven experience as an Engineering Manager leading software teams in complex environments
• Strong experience leading through Tech Leads
• Ability to build leadership depth and scalable team structures
• Solid technical background, able to take part in architecture and design decisions
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across diverse functions
 

Preferred

• Experience in medical device software or other regulated industries
• Background in platform engineering, middleware or shared components
• Experience driving engineering maturity, CI/CD and automation
• Track record of improving quality, reliability and engineering standards
 

Languages

• Fluent professional English (spoken and written) is mandatory
• Dutch and/or French is an advantage but not required
